text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-1789 fired for service=api-gateway -> /v1/generate (high 5xx rate)

pagerduty: auto-escalation: Eng Oncall -> paging Maya (primary) then Irene (secondary)

Maya: acked. seeing a sharp spike in 500s starting ~2819234500. quick grep shows repeated TokenizationError and 'unexpected end of stream' in decoder.

Sahil: linking the alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-1789 - looks like errors are all for model=redwood/llamax-3@promoted-2026-03-14

Maya: exact log sample:
```
2026-03-14T18:12:23Z ERROR request_id=abc123 TokenizationError: Unknown token id 50256
  at Tokenizer.encode (/srv/models/llamax/tokenizer.js:42)
  model_meta.tokenizer: null
```

Irene: I promoted the catalog entry earlier during the rollout window. The promoted variant is a quantized int8 build (llamax-3-q4-int8) but I forgot to include the tokenizer metadata in the catalog manifest when I promoted. That explains the missing tokenizer.vocab.

Maya: that matches. symptoms: 1) host returns 500 with TokenizationError, 2) some streaming responses hang and then time out, 3) overall latency up for that route.

Sahil: customer impact? any high-volume customers hitting this model?

Maya: preliminary: ~12 distinct API keys in the last 5m hit this model; CS flagged 3 paying customers with high qps. Filed ticket CS-9876 for outreach.

Irene: immediate mitigation plan:
- rollback catalog entry to previous revision (promoted-2026-03-13)
- route traffic to fallback model alias 'llamax-stable' for any requests that would hit the promoted revision
- re-promote after fixing manifest + add CI check for tokenizer.meta presence

Maya: executing rollback now.
```bash
# rollback catalog entry
redwoodctl catalog set-revision --model redwood/llamax-3 --revision promoted-2026-03-13 --force
# validate route mapping
redwoodctl routes patch --route /v1/generate --model redwood/llamax-stable --if-current promoted-2026-03-14
```

incident-bot: Command executed by Maya at 2819234610: catalog.set-revision succeeded (op=op-789).

Maya: routing change applied and verifying traffic reroute. metrics show 90% of traffic now hitting llamaX-stable; 5xx rate dropping.

Sahil: safe short-term. Can we also disable auto-promote for that release pipeline until we add the manifest check?

Irene: yes, I disabled the autopromote CI job and will push a manifest validator in the release job. Also adding a canary check that pings tokenizer.encode on promotion.

Maya: customer comms: CS-9876 updated, we've informed the three high-qps customers; no data loss but degraded responses for a small window (~6m).

Irene: followups for next oncall:
- run postmortem draft with timeline + root cause (missing tokenizer metadata during promotion)
- add pre-promotion unit test that loads tokenizer.vocab
- update rollout playbook step to verify model manifest fields
- check if any other models were promoted with incomplete manifests (scan catalog)

Maya: handing off to Irene for post-incident follow-up. All immediate mitigation actions completed: rollback, routing, autopromote disabled, customer outreach started.

NextOncall: taking over. I have read the thread, will kick off the postmortem and follow up with infra to ensure there are no lingering recovery tasks. Leaving a TODO: verify rollback persisted and run end-to-end test on stable alias.

Maya: thanks — ping me if you need logs or the rollback op id (op-789). :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1789 auto-ack cleared at 2819234737 (5xx rate below threshold).

NextOncall: closing the on-call shift note: handoff complete. I'll put the postmortem on the calendar and loop in release owners.
